full_installation.title: Installation Flow
full_installation.info1: Stable version, Vision+Reality, block bt, cn, ads, enable geodata auto-update

xray_version.title: Select Xray Core Version
xray_version.info3: Custom versions may have config compatibility issues

protocol_config.title: Select Node Mode
protocol_config.note_hy2: Note: HY2 uses UDP and requires a domain, IP, or custom TLS certificate.
protocol_config.note_web: Note: SNI uses Nginx; CDN can use Nginx or the low-resource direct Xray TLS backend.
protocol_config.note_multi: Note: Multi-node mode does not include CDN or SNI.
protocol_config.info1: mKCP sacrifices bandwidth to reduce latency.
protocol_config.info2: XTLS(Vision) solves TLS in TLS issue
protocol_config.info3_1: XHTTP has multiplexing by default, lower latency than Vision
protocol_config.info3_2: v2rayN&G clients have global mux.cool settings, disable before using XHTTP
protocol_config.info5: Use VLESS+Vision+REALITY fallback to VLESS+XHTTP on port 443
protocol_config.info6: SNI-based split through Nginx on port 443, supports CDN and direct connection
protocol_config.info7: CDN only (XHTTP over TLS), no REALITY direct link
protocol_config.info8: Hysteria2 based on QUIC(UDP), high performance low latency, requires TLS certificate (domain/IP)
protocol_config.info9: Shadowsocks 2022 is the classic next-gen Shadowsocks protocol, highly secure, using a Pre-Shared Key (PSK)
protocol_config.info10: Generate multiple nodes in one run, with per-node protocol, port, and related settings

web_config.title: Select Camouflage Site Content (CDN/SNI only)
web_config.info2: First registered user in Cloudreve v4 becomes admin

cdn_backend.title: Select CDN Origin Backend
cdn_backend.option1: Nginx TLS reverse proxy (with camouflage site)
cdn_backend.info1: Keeps camouflage sites, Cloudreve, and Nginx management features
cdn_backend.info2: Stops and disables Nginx; Xray listens on 443 directly to reduce memory and background processes
cdn_backend.warning: Direct mode requires HTTPS origin mode (Full/Strict, not Flexible); enable HTTP/2/gRPC at the CDN for streaming XHTTP, and restrict origin port 443 to CDN source IPs where possible.

config_management.title: Configuration Management
config_management.info3: Includes Nginx update, domain change, web config
config_management.info4: Change the Xray listen port for a standalone single-node protocol and restart service
config_management.info6: Configure Xray VLESS reverse proxy, map public port to internal network service
config_management.info7: Connect multiple IPv4 LANs through Xray TUN and dedicated VLESS reverse channels

route_management.title: Custom Routing
route_management.info1: WARP Proxy is deployed via Docker, Docker will be auto-installed.
route_management.info3: Re-applying WARP account frequently may get IP banned by Cloudflare.
route_management.info4: Clear WARP container log files and reset the container.
route_management.info5: Add IP-based block route to ruleTag block-ip.
route_management.info6: Add domain-based block route to ruleTag block-domain.
route_management.info7: (WARP must be enabled) Add WARP IP route to ruleTag warp-ip.
route_management.info8: (WARP must be enabled) Add WARP domain route to ruleTag warp-domain.

cdn_config.title: CDN Site Management
cdn_config.option2: Change or clear downlink CDN domain

cdn_direct_config.title: Low-resource CDN Management
cdn_direct_config.option1: Reconfigure the CDN node or switch backend
cdn_direct_config.option2: Change or clear downlink CDN domain

reverse.title: Reverse Proxy (NAT Traversal)
reverse.info1: Enable reverse proxy in current Xray config (port forwarding mode)
reverse.info2: Remove reverse proxy from current Xray config
reverse.info3: Generate bridge-side Xray config template for internal network devices

lan.info: Initial release supports Linux, IPv4, and non-overlapping private CIDRs; only declared remote CIDRs are routed
